text:
Sara (Support): Handing off urgent P0 from Support -> CS for BlueHarbor pilot. Ingest errors and intermittent timeouts for embeddings over the last ~72h. Pilot go/no-go meeting is in two weeks (2024-04-15). Need CS to lead comms and a remediation plan.

Omar (SE): Noticed repeated 429 from embed service and occasional 502s from the runtime. Root cause looks like batching + a few oversized documents causing KV growth and unexpected kernel switches. Quick fix attempted (rate cap) helped momentarily.

Sara (Support): Example error from customer logs:
```
{
  "status": 429,
  "message": "rate limit exceeded",
  "endpoint": "/v1/embeddings"
}
```

Priya (CS): Marking as P0. Priya here 12: I'll own customer comms. AE, please confirm exec contact so we can copy them. Also want a short mitigations note for the email.

Evan (AE): Claire (CTO) is the exec sponsor, and product owner is Dan. Pilot end date 2024-04-10; theyre evaluating scale & reliability for Q3 rollout. Claire asked for a single-page status.

Lina (Onboard): Do we know customer-side request patterns? Are they sending very long documents or large batches? That will change advice.

Omar (SE): They're on multi-embed with dynamic batching, batch_size=64. Some docs are multi-meg and push sequence length distribution hard. SE recommendation: temp reduce batch_size to 16, enable prefix caching TTL=600, and optionally route to a smaller model variant for high-cost requests.

Priya (CS): Proposed comms: (A) Immediate transparency email to Claire + Dan summarizing issue, impact, and next steps. (B) Schedule 30m technical workshop with their eng team tomorrow to walk through config changes. (C) Offer a 2-week dedicated capacity window if instability continues. Will draft now.

Evan (AE): Agree. Please cc me and Omar. Pull in cost delta if offering dedicated capacity. Keep the email executive-friendly.

Sara (Support): I will collect additional logs and upload sample problematic docs to s3://redwood-shared/blueharbor/esc-171154. Will DM the path.

FinOpsBot: Estimated cost delta for 2-week dedicated capacity (medium pool) = ~+$4,200. This is a rough estimate; FinOps will confirm in 24h.

Omar (SE): I'll sketch a runbook: steps to canary the fallback config, how to monitor token/sequence distribution, and rollback criteria. Can target a canary rollout within 48h once PR approved.

Lina (Onboard): I can run the workshop tomorrow 11am PT. I'll prepare a 10-slide deck and a short preflight checklist (API keys, sampling guide, doc size limits).

Priya (CS): Timeline I'm proposing: Today: transparency email to execs + PO; Today/Tomorrow: workshop (11am PT); 24-48h: apply fallback config canary + extra monitoring; 72h: sync to decide whether to offer/duration of dedicated capacity before pilot decision.

Evan (AE): Claire prefers concise slides showing customer impact and our mitigation timeline. I'll prepare a one-slide summary for execs.

Sara (Support): Action: I'll upload logs and notify Omar once available.

Omar (SE): Action: runbook + fallback PR (24-48h). Will coordinate with Ops for canary.

Lina (Onboard): Action: workshop invite + deck (today, for tomorrow 11am PT).

Priya (CS): Action: draft transparency email now, will post here for 15-min review before send.

Priya (CS): Draft preview: "Claire + Dan: weve identified intermittent ingestion instability caused by large document sizes interacting with dynamic batching. Immediate steps: 1) short-term config changes (reduce batch size, enable prefix caching), 2) workshop with your team to tune pipeline, 3) optional 2-week dedicated capacity window if issues persist. Estimated cost impact TBD (FinOps to confirm). Well implement a canary and monitor closely; expect first mitigations within 48h."

Evan (AE): Looks good. Suggest adding an explicit ETA for the workshop and who will attend from our side.

Priya (CS): Good call. I'll add Lina, Omar, and Evan as attendees.

FinOpsBot: FinOps will confirm the cost estimate within 24h.

Sara (Support): Upload complete. Path DM'd to Omar.

Omar (SE): Received sample docs. I'll start testing locally and prepare the PR.

Priya (CS): Sending the email in ~20m. Thanks team.

Sara (Support): Marking this as handback P0 -> CS.

Priya (CS): Will follow up in this thread with send time and any replies from Claire.
